groundRule: a ground tile is exactly ppt x ppt px (the scene's depth is stretched by 1/sin(35)); heights show at ppt*cos(35) px per tile

groundRect.note: the image's ground area in tiles

chest-closed.anchorNote: the point of the image that sits on the anchor spot (default: bottom-centre of the footprint)
chest-closed.note: v2 closed chest idle loop (1 s at 12 fps): a gentle bob, a glint down a gold band, the jewel twinkles. Layers: chest, chest-glow, chest-fx

groundRect.note: the image's ground area in tiles

chest-open.anchorNote: the point of the image that sits on the anchor spot (default: bottom-centre of the footprint)
chest-open.note: v2 opening, once (2.5 s at 12 fps), then chest-opened. 0-11 bigger and bigger shakes and hops with light leaking out, 12 the lid bursts open: beam, stars, sparkles and gold coins fly out

groundRect.note: the image's ground area in tiles

chest-opened.anchorNote: the point of the image that sits on the anchor spot (default: bottom-centre of the footprint)
chest-opened.note: v2 open chest idle loop (1 s at 12 fps): breathing glow and twinkles. Same size and anchor as chest-open
